approvers: Owner decides alone; I only recommend
reason: ACHV is a contractor too and I don't want a competitor on my site seeing my programme. We don't buy this today, so it means a new budget line and a new supplier, and the owner decides after one site visit and a quote.
objection: A competing contractor on my site, seeing my programme and my clients, for a coating I can get done cheaper with a roll of film and a labourer.
instead: Keep protecting glazing with cheap film and tape and our own labourers, and pay for the odd repair when something gets scratched.
would_change_my_mind: The product supplied only, from a neutral distributor, with no ACHV people on site, plus a Maltese contractor reference who used it and saw less glazing damage and lower snagging costs.
